tracks.title: 行頭排
tracks.subject: a 42-year-old office worker who last played trombone in his school band in 1999, roped in by his niece, drum major of a Tuen Mun youth marching band, when the band's only trombonist flies to Osaka for Lunar New Year; marching in the front row of the Lunar New Year night parade in Tsim Sha Tsui he misses her whistle to halt, plays on alone into a squad of American cheerleaders, and ducks to the roadside until his band's bass drum catches up

tracks.title: 六件蛋撻
tracks.subject: six office friends dressed as a box of egg tarts in the South Stand at the first Hong Kong Sevens at Kai Tak, dancing all weekend and missing every try, including the one in the final

tracks.title: 寫咗先望
tracks.subject: a shy man who sings the scholar's part in a Saturday amateur Cantonese-opera singing club in a To Kwa Wan community hall, paired for the annual show in a duet with the woman who joined in March, who only looks at her where the teacher has pencilled the word 'look' into his score, until on show night he opens it at the music stand and finds she has pencilled one beside every line

tracks.title: 四個一齊到
tracks.mood: grinding, stubborn, sweaty and a bit absurd
tracks.subject: four office colleagues doing the Oxfam Trailwalker, 100 km of the MacLehose Trail in under 48 hours where all four must cross the line together, and the one who sits down on the Lion Rock steps at 3 a.m. to quit

tracks.title: 第四隻東風
tracks.subject: one of the last hand-carvers of mahjong tiles, in a narrow Jordan shopfront, spending three afternoons carving a single East Wind to replace the one a Yau Ma Tei table has gone without for years in a forty-year-old set his own master carved, copying the master's long-tailed stroke from the three surviving East tiles and steeping the too-white blank in pu'er until its yellow matches by eye in the doorway's afternoon sun

tracks.title: 推車恰恰
tracks.mood: cheeky, bustling and quick on her feet
tracks.subject: a dim sum trolley auntie at one of Hong Kong's last old-style trolley teahouses who knows every regular's order by the sound of their walk, pushing her squeaking trolley through the Sunday morning rush

tracks.title: 清醒一鏢
tracks.subject: a Wan Chai pub darts team of six minibus drivers who need double-top with the last dart to win the Kowloon league final, and their thrower, who has never hit it sober, stuck on lemon tea because he drives the 5 a.m. first run

tracks.title: 一部計數機
tracks.subject: two adults in their thirties retaking the DSE at a Mong Kok evening school who share her calculator all term because his battery is dead, though she has seen the unopened pack of new batteries in his bag, and who open their results envelopes together on the school steps

tracks.title: 粉紅馬頭圍道
tracks.subject: a To Kwa Wan neon-sign maker hand-bending glass tubes over a gas flame through the night to finish a four-metre sign for Bing Kee, a noodle shop reopening that evening, down to the twenty-stroke character for noodles, until he flips the switch and Ma Tau Wai Road turns pink

tracks.title: 換香
tracks.subject: a Tai Hang local who runs beside the 67-metre fire dragon on Mid-Autumn night with a bag of joss sticks, pulling out the burnt-down ones and pushing in fresh ones through the smoke

tracks.title: 跟唔到鼓
tracks.mood: frantic, cheeky and laughing at itself
tracks.subject: a rookie paddler on a Tuen Ng dragon boat crew at Stanley who keeps losing the drummer's beat and splashing the whole boat

tracks.title: 六點交更
tracks.mood: sleepy, warm and quietly in love
tracks.subject: a nurse coming off night shift and her boyfriend leaving for his morning job sharing a twenty-minute breakfast at six a.m., the only time their days overlap

tracks.title: 請按零字
tracks.subject: a man stuck on hold with his bank's hotline for an hour, the same hold tune looping and the recorded voice telling him his call is important

tracks.title: 冷氣滴水
tracks.subject: a woman awake at 3 a.m. counting the rhythm of the upstairs air-conditioner dripping onto her metal window awning, and finally going up in her slippers to knock

tracks.title: 十點轉向
tracks.subject: an office worker sprinting up the Central-Mid-Levels escalator stairs at 9:58 a.m. before it switches from downhill to uphill at ten
